title: Harvest Reporting, Timely Information and Incentives for Technology Adoption
Risk Preferences and Compliance in Recreational Fisheries
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: This paper studies the returns on the allocation of harvest to the recreational sector when anglers exhibit risk aversion for random catch. By using data from choice experiments that explicitly introduce uncertainty in harvest as a trip attribute, we specify and estimate different models of constant absolute risk aversion (CARA). With evidence that anglers exhibit disutility from randomness in the catch, we use our estimates to draw comparisons with standard linear models. We calibrate a model of the Northeast Region summer flounder fishery and run Monte Carlo experiments to simulate alternative policy strategies for enforcing the recreational total allowable catch (TAC). Our results show that risk aversion leads to different predictions on angler participation and welfare from those assuming risk neutrality. Unlike the case of risk neutrality, the same TAC enforced with different catch restrictions and season lengths results in different numbers of expected trips and welfare estimates under CARA preferences. It is the entire catch distribution rather than the mean catch that determines anglers’ behavior and implied values. Under risk aversion for random catch, regulators may also find enforcement of harvest restrictions to be less costly. More broadly, our approach provides a consistent way to incorporate risk in quality attributes into the discrete choice framework that is pervasive in the literature on recreational demand modeling.
abstract_zh: 本文研究当垂钓者对随机渔获量表现出风险厌恶时，将捕捞量分配给休闲部门的收益。利用将捕捞量不确定性明确作为出行属性引入的选择实验数据，我们设定并估计了多种不变绝对风险厌恶（CARA）模型。由于证据表明垂钓者对渔获随机性存在负效用，我们利用估计结果与标准线性模型进行比较。我们校准了东北地区夏季比目鱼渔业的模型，并通过蒙特卡洛实验模拟了执行休闲部门总可捕量（TAC）的不同政策策略。结果表明，风险厌恶会导致与风险中性假设下不同的垂钓者参与和福利预测。与风险中性情形不同，在CARA偏好下，即使以不同的渔获限制和捕捞季节长度执行相同的TAC，也会产生不同的预期出行次数和福利估计。决定垂钓者行为及隐含价值的是整个渔获分布，而非平均渔获量。在随机渔获存在风险厌恶的情况下，监管者可能还会发现执行捕捞限制的成本较低。更广泛地看，我们的方法为在离散选择框架中一致地纳入质量属性中的风险提供了途径，而这一框架在休闲需求建模文献中十分普遍。

title: Property Rights and Choice: The Case of the Fishery
abstract: Formal property rights are typically established after considerable waste has occurred, despite the effectiveness of such schemes in addressing the inefficiencies of common pool resources. Adoption can be contentious because of the assignment of wealth and political influence that accompany the transition to exclusive property rights. This paper studies how the early involvement of harvesters in policy implementation designed to address the commons’ inefficiency may foster perceived legitimacy and lessen political opposition to the establishment of individual property rights. We demonstrate that it is optimal for a manager facing industry strife and reform delay to allow firms to self‐select into the property rights regime. The strategic interaction of harvesters leads to an equilibrium characterized by the global adoption of property rights. Thus, by providing harvesters with a choice between management systems, policy makers can reduce the transaction costs associated with the need to create political consensus, while ensuring an outcome similar to the top‐down implementation of market‐based management. Evidence is provided from a recent policy change in Maryland fisheries in which the provision of a choice resulted in the overwhelming adoption of individual transferable quotas and the end of the race to fish.
abstract_zh: 正式的产权通常是在大量浪费已经发生之后才建立的，尽管此类制度在解决公共池塘资源低效问题上行之有效。由于向排他性产权过渡会伴随财富分配和政治影响力的重新分配，其采纳往往充满争议。本文研究在旨在解决公地低效问题的政策实施中，捕捞者的早期参与如何有助于培育合法性认知，并减轻建立个人产权时的政治阻力。我们证明，对于面临行业冲突和改革拖延的管理者而言，允许企业自我选择进入产权制度是最优的。捕捞者之间的策略互动会形成一种以产权制度全面采纳为特征的均衡。因此，通过为捕捞者提供管理制度之间的选择，政策制定者可以降低达成政治共识所需的交易成本，同时确保达到与市场化管理自上而下实施相似的结果。来自马里兰州渔业近期政策变动的证据显示，选择机会的提供使得个人可转让配额（ITQ）被广泛采纳，并终结了“抢鱼竞赛”。
